candidates.title: City station readings (hourly), NO2 and PM2.5
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal hourly NO2 and PM2.5 source. Catalog temporal_coverage starts 2023-01-01 (end null), so it covers the production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31 but not the prototype window. ts_utc is UTC, which eases joins to weather. Owner Environment Monitoring Unit; access by request via warehouse SQL.
suspected_issues: Wiki station_network (last_edited 2024-07-01): station VR-03 (Via Roma) switched off 2024-06-30, yet catalog still lists the network as active; VR-03 has no readings after that date.
Catalog has no unit/validation flag column (only no2_ugm3, pm25_ugm3); validated vs provisional status unknown.
Station location/type (urban/traffic/background) not recorded in catalog; station-to-counter mapping not documented.
Request-process status and expected date for access unknown (open question in search plan).

candidates.title: Road traffic counts (hourly)
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal hourly vehicle-count source near the monitoring stations. Catalog coverage from 2021-01-01, so it spans the production window. Owner Mobility Office.
suspected_issues: Wiki counter_replacement_2024 (last_edited 2024-04-02): counters replaced 2024-03-18; counts were per direction before and both directions combined after. Do not compare across the change without adjustment; catalog has no note.
ts_local is local time, while the air-quality feed is UTC: DST handling needed for hourly joins.
No documented mapping from counter_id to monitoring station or road segment distance (N2 acceptance criterion).
Missing hours / outage rates not documented.

candidates.title: Respiratory visits (daily, by district)
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregate daily respiratory visit counts by district, the only clinic data the policy allows. Catalog coverage from 2022-01-01, so it covers the production window. Contains no patient identifiers per catalog. Owner Clinical Analytics.
suspected_issues: Wiki clinic_data_policy (last_edited 2025-02-01) names this table as the only permitted clinic source; small-cell suppression threshold not set in any source (Legal open question).
Diagnosis / respiratory definition and any coding change mid-period not documented in catalog.
District code system and boundary changes not documented; joinability to other data unknown.
Columns are only visit_date, district, visit_count; no stated consent/sign-off record found.

candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
candidates.why_relevant: Register entry approved for prototyping and production with open-data status; provides hourly temperature_2m and relative_humidity_2m. Only candidate for N3 in both windows.
suspected_issues: Register default coordinates are Lisbon (38.72, -9.14); must be replaced with a justified Valdena location recorded as an assumption in decisions.md. No source names the client's city.
Reanalysis (modelled), not station observation; may not reflect street-level conditions.
Register does not state archive start date; coverage of 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04 and 2024-2025 must be confirmed by a short probe.
Register default query uses hourly temperature_2m,shortwave_radiation; humidity must be added to the variable list.

rejected_without_profiling.reason: Agreement expired: contract AD-2021-114 ran to 2025-12-31, renewal waiting on Procurement with no signed renewal; API key revoked 2026-01-01. Not usable for N3.
Patient-level records (N5) are out of scope; Clinic data policy (wiki clinic_data_policy) forbids use for this analysis and personal data (postcode, age band) must not leave clinic systems.

Register entry is for holidays, which serve no listed need directly; could only act as an optional calendar covariate for N2 pitfalls. Default country is PT and would need changing to IT. Not a candidate for any need.

unmet_needs: N1 prototype (public hourly NO2/PM2.5, 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04): no internal or register source. The register holds only the open-data policy, which is not a dataset. Needs a human-supplied link to an Italian public hourly series (ARPA/ISPRI/EEA) with a station whose location and validation status are documented. Internal station data starts 2023-01-01 and cannot serve it.

N1 production fallback: the internal station feed covers the window, but the city's station-data request status and owner date are unknown. A public equivalent (regional ARPA / EEA) needs a link if the internal request is delayed.
N2 production: internal counter data exists but has no documented mapping to stations, and no register traffic source exists. Any external traffic feed needs its own agreement and Legal review.
N3 station-based alternative: no internal or register source. Regional ARPA meteo station data would need a human-supplied link. The AtmosData feed is unusable.

N4 daily counts: internal coverage from 2022 is adequate, but the small-cell suppression threshold and the lawful-basis / sign-off are not documented in the sources reviewed. Regional aggregate health statistics are monthly or annual and do not meet the grain.
N5: rejected under the clinic data policy (patient-level records out of scope). Not pursued.
N6 national PM2.5 attributable deaths (ISTAT / ISS / EEA, Italy, annual): no internal or register source. Needs a human-supplied link with the attribution method and vintage stated.
City identity and station coordinates: no source names the client's city. The Open-Meteo coordinates depend on a justified assumption, to be recorded in decisions.md.
